lines.en: label makotopool55:
scene makotomikupool1

I make my way over to the pool to spend some time with two girls I will one day have a threesome with because, despite Makoto showing no interest in doing that with Miku, we all know it will happen one day.
I mean, just look at them. Those are the faces of two best friends who are longing to share the same penis.
But I digress.
The real reason I’m here is to see if Makoto is still sticking to her “Live because others want you to” plan or however it was she worded it on the rooftop the other day.
It’s admirable. Foolish, but admirable.
It’s important to note, however, that I am a man who is living almost entirely for his self, so I am very likely a bit biased.
I guess what really matters at the end of the day is that Makoto stays grounded. How she does that is up to her. Just like how much she enjoys it is up to her as well (depression aside).
Moving forward is a good place to start.
I just hope she doesn’t wind up walking around in circles.
: Hello, ladies.
scene makotomikupool2
: Uhh...hello Sir?
: Sensei! Been meanin’ to call ya! Congratulations!
: For what? What did I do?
scene makotomikupool3
: Ya finally locked lips with my BFF after a billion years, that’s what! Took ya long enough, you sly dog.
: Oh, good. So it appears that Makoto is just as open about our relationship behind closed doors as you.
: That’s what best friends are for. Duh. ‘Sides, you two’ve already done the nasty a good hundred times by now. Kissin’ ain’t nothin’.
: Seems like a lot to Makoto based on her reaction.
: Oh, you know...It was only something I was looking forward to for...practically forever.
: How’d ya do it? Tongue? No tongue? She good? Better than me?
: I have no further interest in discussing this with you, Miku.
scene makotomikupool4
: Guh. You men and your damn secrets.
: I haven’t told anyone else. Don’t worry.
: Who else would you even tell? Your mom?
scene makotomikupool5
: I have other friends! Touka and I hang out sometimes! And I’ve come over to your house on several occasions just to see Ami!
: Oh, maybe I should tell Maki we’re a thing now? She could probably give me all sortsa cool sex tips.
: Miku, apart from Makoto, just never tell anyone about anything we do ever. Okay?
: Not even if it means missin’ out on cool sex tips?
: I can assure you that Makoto can give you all of the “cool sex tips” you need.
scene makotomikupool6
: Do you know how to do that thing where you unlock your jaw? Can you teach me? That sounds useful.
: Sure. Just as soon as Sensei remembers that I’m the one who’s supposed to be bullying him now.
: Hey, don’t get mad at me. This is almost entirely Miku’s fault.
: The reason I wanna know how to do the jaw thing is cause-
scene makotomikupool7
: You don’t have to tell me everything, Miku! Come on!
: Well ‘scuse me for wantin’ to cash in on the cool sex tips I was promised.
: There’s nothing I can teach you that the Internet can’t! These are things you can look up on your own time!
: Time?! But I barely have any time to-
scene makotomikupool8
: Oh, crap.
: Crap? Why crap?
: I, uhh...
scene makotomikupool9
: I was supposed to meet up with Kirin to do some study thing! Because, you know, I’m an idiot.
: What do you have to study for? We just finished all of our testing. Also, why didn’t you ask me?
: Cause...you’re too hard on me. And Kirin ain’t that smart either, so...I’m just gonna go do stuff with her.
: Then...let me get dressed and I’ll come with you. I don’t have work tonight so-
scene makotomikupool10
: Nah, nah...don’t even worry about it. I’ll get outta your hair so you and Sensei can have some more alone time.
: I really don’t mind-
scene makotomikupool11
: Go easy on ‘er, ya hear? No grabbin’ where the sun don’t shine in public places.
: Tell Io I said hi.
scene makotomikupool12
: It’s...Kirin.
scene makotomikupool13
Miku scampers off and, unfortunately, I have a pretty good idea of where she’s going.
: Io?
: Why would Miku be going to see Io?
scene makotomikupool14
: Maybe there’s something Io can do for her that no one else can?
: You mean, like...woodwork?
: Exactly, Makoto. Miku is secretly into woodwork, but is extremely embarrassed about it. Also, how do you even know Io is into that sort of thing?
scene makotomikupool15
: I’ve had to give her the key to the woodshop on several occasions now. Also, anyone could tell she spends her free time on something physical just by looking at her hands.
: What does any of that have to do with Miku, though? Why would you assume she’s hanging out with Io?
: I don’t know if they’re “hanging out.” I just know she goes to see her sometimes.
: For...wood?
: Yes.
scene makotomikupool16
: Sensei, what’s going on? Because between this and that weird “joke” you made when the two of us came over to play games, I’m starting to feel really weird.
: I’ve also noticed that Miku’s been a little different than normal lately, so if you have any sort of insight into that, I’d greatly appreciate it.
: Weird how? What’s different about her?
scene makotomikupool17
: Nothing...bad I guess. Just different. Maybe a little more focused and...less...Miku-ish?
: So...more like a normal girl?
: Like I said, it’s not bad. She’s just seemed a little...off. But I don’t see what that has to do with Io.
: Then ask her. It’s not my place to reveal all of Miku’s secrets, but I’ll be damned if I don’t repeatedly hint at them until you do something about it yourself.
: Yeah, well...I’m barely in the position to do that when I know I’ve probably been exactly the same as her.
scene black
Makoto pulls herself out of the pool and grabs a towel off a nearby rack to dry herself off before heading over to a bench.
scene makotomikupool18
As I join her on said bench, I need to once again remind myself of how annoyed I am by those who meddle in my affairs and that I’d be no better than them by following in their footsteps.
It would be different to directly involve myself with Makoto’s affairs, though...wouldn’t it?
Doesn’t she want me to get involved with her problems? Isn’t that why she didn’t oppose me sitting down beside her?
This isn’t like the Miku thing at all. Whatever is going on now is something that I’m a part of.
: Maybe it’s just stress.
Or maybe whatever is going on now is much smaller than I anticipated-
And these rare worries of mine were all for nothing.
: Stress?
: The feeling of emotional or physical tension.
: I know what stress is, Makoto. I was asking why you’d think that.
: I get that you have plenty on your plate, but what does Miku have to be stressed about?
: Lack of purpose. Bad grades. Diving into a sexually active life despite barely any prior knowledge and zero experience. Romance as a whole. The weight of competition.
: There’s plenty for Miku to be stressed about. But, even if there wasn’t, it could still very well be that.
: You never need a reason to be stressed. Some people simply just are.
: Is there...anything I can do to help with that?
scene makotomikupool19
: Help me? Or Miku? Which one are we talking about?
: You.
: Probably. Have you progressed past the point where your go-to solution is to just massage the stress out of me?
: I think so. I’m a lot different now than I was back then.
: Good. Because, in hindsight, that was very creepy. And if I didn’t spend so much time fantasizing about that exact scenario, I probably would have filed a complaint.
: Just tell me what I can do, Makoto. I’m tired of letting you handle all of this on your own and I really do want to be better to you.
scene makotomikupool20
: That’s...really sweet, Sensei.
: Unfortunately, I don’t think there’s much you can do.
: Like I said the other day, this is just...kind of how I exist now. I’m a big, tense bottle of anguish and despair- emptied only by the hand of fate itself.
scene makotomikupool21
: I’ve taken some big steps lately, though.
: In fact, the vast majority of what I’ve said to you over the last few days has been the result of a lot of hard work and lot of...really difficult conversations.
: My mom and Miku did a lot for me when I was struggling. I know that...But I think Ami and Touka were the ones who helped me more than anyone.
: It was kind of like therapy in a way. Touka allowed me to vent and Ami taught me new ways to cope and helped me better understand the world I’m in now.
: Why not...go to actual therapy?
scene makotomikupool22
: I think I might. We have good insurance, so I’d be able to see someone without it being a financial burden. I’ve just always felt weird about things like that.
: That’s because you’re like me. You bottle things up until there’s nowhere else to put them.
: How have you managed to go so long without bursting, Sensei? I’m really curious.
: Between the coping techniques and emotional outbursts, Ami also helped me realize just how hard you were hit when-
scene makotomikupool23
: I’ve managed to go so long by doing the exact opposite of what you’ve been doing. And, sorry for interrupting, but I don’t think I’m going to change that just by hearing about your success.
: That doesn’t stop me from being happy for you, though.
: What if it’s me?
: What if what is you?
: What if you talk to me about your feelings? I can be your Ami. Or your Touka.
: I already have an Ami and a Touka and I wouldn’t want to talk about this with either of them.
: I won’t force you, of course. The unending weight of “opening up” is still fresh on my mind after the lot of you barraged me at the height of my misery.
: In fact, I won’t even tell you that I’ll be here for you if you want to open up as I’m sure I’ve said that many times in the past...and that it’s already ingrained into your mind.
: But if you ever start ranting, I won’t stop you.
: And if you ever want me to be more for you than I already am, I will.
: With all due respect, there are at least ten other girls who would say the same exact thing to me right now.
: That might be true.
scene makotomikupool24
: But none of them are me. And, all things considered, I think I’m pretty awesome.
: Plus, I know I’ve locked down a special place somewhere in your heart even if you won’t admit it.
: Like it or not, the two of us are in this thing together — and we can empty out each other’s bottles whenever we get full since we’re too stubborn to empty them out ourselves.
: Thanks Makoto, but...this is a little bit nicer than you’re supposed to be acting toward me now.
: You’re right. Give me all your lunch money.
scene makotomikupool25
: That’s more like it. Thank you.
: Whatever you need. And I’m not just saying that as your secretary slash assistant slash friend slash girlfriend slash fuck buddy slash porno clerk.
: Then that leaves...
: Just Makoto.
scene black
: And whatever you want me to be next.
The next half hour goes by without much conversation before Makoto has to take off for another “therapy” session with my niece.
Everything she said today, I already knew.
But there was something different about the way she said it that makes her feel like a brand new person.
And I don’t know what to make her next.
But whatever it is, I hope it’s a role that makes her feel like she’s doing a little more than just “existing.”
